behavior_constraints: When all four new flags are absent, every existing output (--output, --rejects, --state-out, --audit-log, --audit-log-digest, --out-parquet-manifest, --manifest-signature) remains byte-for-byte unchanged; no runtime-derived field is added to any existing output

Empty value for --summary-schema-out (or --summary-schema-digest/--summary-schema-index) is a usage error: exit code 2, no output files created, stderr 'ingest: --summary-schema-out: value must be non-empty' (parse-time check)
Parent directory of --summary-schema-out path must already exist; otherwise exit 2, no output files created, stderr 'ingest --summary-schema-out parent directory does not exist'
Parent directory of --summary-schema-digest path must already exist; otherwise exit 2, no output files created, stderr 'ingest --summary-schema-digest parent directory does not exist'
--summary-schema-digest without --summary-schema-out is an error: exit 2, no output files created, stderr 'ingest: --summary-schema-digest requires --summary-schema-out'
Validation order: empty-value check at parse time; parent-directory-exists and cross-flag dependency checks run before any output file is written
Schema sidecar is written after every other output (except optional digest sidecar) including after --output, derived deterministically from the bytes just written to --output
Schema sidecar is pretty-printed JSON with 2-space indentation and a trailing newline, written atomically via .tmp+rename (same discipline as --out-parquet-manifest)
Top-level keys of schema sidecar appear in exact order: schema_version, summary_schema, ingest_id, run_index, field_summary, strict_mode
entities.summary: This round adds optional schema-sidecar support to eventq ingest via four new flags (--summary-schema-out, --summary-schema-digest, --summary-schema-strict, --summary-schema-index) that emit deterministic read-only derivations of the just-written --output summary JSON, without altering any existing output when the flags are absent.

instruction_head:
# Summary Schema Sidecars

Add optional schema-sidecar support to `eventq ingest`. The new
`--summary-schema-out <path>` flag writes a sidecar describing the actual
current-run shape of the `--output` summary JSON. The companion
`--summary-schema-digest <path>` flag writes a content-addressed digest for
that schema sidecar. `--summary-schema-strict` tightens only the schema
sidecar derivation rules, and `--summary-schema-index <path>` writes a
separate index over the derived schema.
